Clear.Label: clear
Clear.Description: A clear day. No penalties or modifiers.

Fog.Label: fog
Fog.Description: Fog reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons.

Rain.Label: rain
Rain.Description: Rain reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

DryThunderstorm.Label: dry thunderstorm
DryThunderstorm.Description: Dry thunderstorms are dangerous because the lightning can start fires and there is no rain to put them out.

RainyThunderstorm.Label: rainy thunderstorm
RainyThunderstorm.Description: The lightning will start fires, but the rain will put it out. The rain also reduces movement speed and shooting accuracy.

SnowHard.Label: hard snow
SnowHard.Description: Snow reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

SnowGentle.Label: gentle snow
SnowGentle.Description: Snow reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

BloodRain.Label: blood rain
BloodRain.Description: Anyone exposed to the blood rain for long enough will be driven into a berserk rage. Certain traits and psychic sensitivity influence the berserk effect.

ToxRain.Label: tox rain
ToxRain.Description: Tox rain makes creatures sick with toxic buildup. It also reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

Sandstorm.Label: sandstorm
Sandstorm.Description: Sandstorms reduce the accuracy of ranged weapons, slow people down, and get sand everywhere.

BlindFog.Label: blind fog
BlindFog.Description: A heavy fog that reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, as well as their maximum range.

Overcast.Label: overcast
Overcast.Description: Thick clouds obscure the sky, reducing light levels.

Blizzard.Label: blizzard
Blizzard.Description: Snow reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

TorrentialRain.Label: torrential rain
TorrentialRain.Description: Torrential rain causes flooding. It also reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire, and slows people down.

VEE_Whiteout.Label: whiteout
VEE_Whiteout.Description: Heavy, chilling snow that severely reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons, extinguishes fire and slows people down.

VEE_PsychicRain.Label: psychic rain
VEE_PsychicRain.Description: A seemingly supernatural rain that alters the very composition of time. Any person or creature not under a roof will age significantly faster.

VEE_LongNight.Label: long night
VEE_LongNight.Description: A catastrophic celestial eclipse that blankets the world in an endless, freezing twilight, forcing the world to adapt to artificial light and increased psychic sensitivity as nocturnal predators and subterranean threats emerge in the darkness.

VPE_Hurricane.Label: hurricane
VPE_Hurricane.Description: Extreme wind will cause a slowdown to everyone not under the roof.

RG_Windy.Label: Breezy
RG_Windy.Description: Consistent wind that reduces ranged weapon accuracy.

RG_Drizzle.Label: drizzle
RG_Drizzle.Description: Very light but prominent rain which slightly reduces ranged weapon accuracy and movement speed.

RG_FogStorm.Label: fog storm
RG_FogStorm.Description: Rolling fog and heavy wind reduces the accuracy of ranged weapons.

RG_FoggySnow.Label: foggy snow
RG_FoggySnow.Description: Heavy snow with fog that reduces ranged weapon accuracy, extinguishes fires and reduces movement speed.

IsekaiThickMist.Label: whale-mist
IsekaiThickMist.Description: An unnatural, soupy mist conjured by the Whale of the Mist. It clings to everything and swallows sight at a few paces. Ranged fire is nearly useless inside it.
IsekaiThickMist.ModSource: ISEKAI CREATURES ADD-ON - Isekai RPG Leveling

OAGene_SnowExtreme.Label: Extreme snowstorm
OAGene_SnowExtreme.Description: Extreme snowstorm and extremely poor visibility make it unwise to go out in such weather.

OAGene_IceSnowExtreme.Label: Ice crystal blizzard
OAGene_IceSnowExtreme.Description:
Extreme blizzards are mixed with a large amount of wind and snow crystals, which are sharp and icy. These ice crystals can make the already cold blizzard even more deadly and can also injure anyone who is not under the roof.
In this weather, the snow and wind crystal collector will operate at an incredible speed until it is completely filled.

OAGene_IceRain.Label: Ice crystal rain
OAGene_IceRain.Description:
Ice crystals appear sporadically in the form of sparse raindrops, which can cause a slight decrease in temperature and potentially injure anyone outdoors.
If a wind and snow crystal collector is established, it will be able to collect a certain amount of wind and snow crystals.

OAGene_StarryNight.Label: Starry night
OAGene_StarryNight.Description: The magnificent starry and moonlit night is almost a once-in-a-century wonder on this planet.

Sinnamon_Windy.Label: whirlwind
Sinnamon_Windy.Description: Wind is increasing the wind turbine output. More Ritual Rewards

VGE_DustCloud.Label: dust cloud
VGE_DustCloud.Description: A dense cosmic dust cloud has drifted across your sector, shrouding your gravship in particulate haze. Visibility is almost zero, and targeting systems are struggling to lock onto anything. The dust will eventually clear as the cloud drifts away. Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapter 1

VGE_ToxicDustCloud.Label: toxic dust cloud
VGE_ToxicDustCloud.Description: A drifting cloud of highly toxic cosmic dust has enveloped your gravship. Microscopic particulates are seeping into every exposed space, corroding surfaces and poisoning the crew. Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapter 1

Kurin_Weather_KumihoDomain.Label: Lady Gumi's domain
Kurin_Weather_KumihoDomain.Description: A domain of Lady Gumi. Kurin, The Three Tailed Fox (Deluxe Edition)
Kurin_Weather_KumihoDomain.ModSource: Kurin, The Three Tailed Fox [Deluxe Edition]
